newsitem.title: UK: S&P eyes EA-Generali talks re.
newsitem.headline: S&P eyes EA-Generali talks re.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Tuesday it was monitoring talks between EA-Generali and the Austrian government as there were possible rating implications for Creditanstalt-Bankverein.
This follows news that EA-Generali submitted a bid for the government's 70 percent holding of the voting shares of Creditantstalt.
"At the moment, information concerning any possible takeover is insufficient for Standard & Poor's to take any rating action," it said in a statement.

"However, the ratings of Creditanstalt reflect the government's partial owernership of the bank. Any change in its shareholders' structure, therefore, could have implications for the ratings of Creditanstalt, given the bank's difficult operating environment and modest profitability levels."

S&P said the current A1 short term ratings for Creditanstalt and Creditanstalt Finance Inc reflect its majority ownership by the Austrian government, the bank's strong market position in Austria, its market position in Central and Eastern Europe and its role as a major corporate sector in its domestic market.
